City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council Amy M. Turner, City Clerk
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
APRIL 22, 2008
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Council Members Present: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan (Solis arrived at 7:18 p.m.)
Staff Members Present: City Manager Cowley, Assistant City Manager Yamachika, City Attorney Casso, City Clerk Turner, Deputy City Clerk Giron, Finance Director Kim, Public Works Director Salas, City Planner Arreola,Recreation Director Bistarkey.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATION
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO CHIEF NIETO FOR HIS RETIREMENT
Commendation
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION FOR MUNICIPAL CLERKS WEEK - MAY 4 - MAY 10, 2008
Proclamation
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 11, 2008 AND THE REGULAR MEETING OF APRIL 8, 2008.
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of March 11, 2008 and April 8, 2008 as presented.
Minutes 3/11/2008
Minutes 4/8/2008
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-2
REQUEST TO CONSIDER PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY FOR THEIR FOURTH ANNUAL LA PUENTE "RELAY FOR LIFE" (Requested by Mayor Pro Tem Holloway)
No Recommendation.
Relay for Life Report
E-3
REQUEST TO CONSIDER JOINING SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS (SCAG) (Requested by Mayor Lujan)
No Recommendation.
SCAG Report
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING SUPPORT FOR THE SINGLE-USE BAG REDUCTION AND RECYCLING PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 08-4707 authorizing the support of the Single-Use Bag Reduction and Recycling Program and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute all necessary coordination between the City and the County in developing a coordinated countywide implementation strategy that will significantly reduce the environmental damage caused by plastic bags for the benefit of all of our constituents.
Single-Use Bag Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
APPEAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION AND DEVELOPMENT REVIEW BOARD DECISIONS TO APPROVE APPLICATIONS UUP-239 AND DPA-1048, FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1009 HACIENDA BOULEVARD (Continued from April 8, 2008.)
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the Public Hearing, take public testimony, and close the public hearing; (2) adopt Resolution No. 08-4704, upholding the Planning Commission's decision to approve Unclassified Use Permit No. 239; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 08-4705, upholding the Development Review Board's decision to approve Development Plan Application No. 1048.
UUP 239 Report
Attachments A-F
Attachment G
Attachment H
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
PRESENTATION OF UPDATE ON SEWER SERVICE CHARGES (Presented by Hilton, Farnkopf & Hobson)
Presentation
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1.
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1225 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 08-4706 approving warrant register number 1225.
Warrant Register No. 1225 Resolution
D-3
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council approve the CDBG Housing Rehabilitation Program Summary monthly report and authorize that it be filed for audit.
Monthly CDBG Housing Report
Attachments
D-4
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM REUSE ACCOUNT AND ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the CalHome Housing Rehabilitation Program report and authorize that it be filed for audit.
Monthly CalHome Housing Report
Attachments
D-5
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT DESIGN/BUILD REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS FOR A NEW HVAC SYSTEM AT CITY HALL
It is recommended that the City Council authorize staff to solicit Request for Qualification for design/build of a new HVAC system to be installed at City Hall.
City Hall HVAC Report
Attachment A
D-6
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE HANDICAPPED RAMPS AND SIDEWALKS - GROUP 2 (CDBG # 601096-07)
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the current plans and specifications for the Handicapped Ramps and Sidewalks Project-Group 2; and (2) authorize staff to solicit bids.
Handicapped Ramps and Sidewalk Report
Attachment A
D-7
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR INSTALLATION OF A TRAFFIC SIGNAL ON TEMPLE AVE AT SUNKIST AVENUE PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the plans and specifications; and (2) authorize staff to solicit bids for the installation of a traffic signal on Temple Avenue at Sunkist Avenue project.
Traffic Signal Report
Attachment A
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF ACCEPTANCE FOR SENIOR CENTER IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT-AIR-CONDITIONING UNIT REPLACEMENT
It is recommended that the City Council accept the Senior Center Improvements Project-air-conditioning portion as complete and authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion and release of payment to Air Flow Mechanical
Senior Center AC Report
Attachment A
D-2
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR PROFESSIONAL AUDITING SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council award the contract for auditing services to Teaman Ramirez & Smith Inc. CPAs as the lowest responsible bidder.
Auditing Services Report
Attachment A

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
April 22, 2008
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on April 22, 2008, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Council Members Present: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan (Solis arrived at 7:18 p.m.)
Staff Members Present: City Manager Cowley, Assistant City Manager Yamachika, City Attorney Casso, City Clerk Turner, Deputy City Clerk Giron, Finance Director Kim, Public Works Director Salas, City Planner Arreola,Recreation Director Bistarkey.

Minutes 3/11/2008
Minutes 4/8/2008
Lujan moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of March 11, 2008 and April 8, 2008 as presented; seconded by Holloway.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Holloway, and Mendoza. NOES: None.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-2
REQUEST TO CONSIDER PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY FOR THEIR FOURTH ANNUAL LA PUENTE "RELAY FOR LIFE" (Requested by Mayor Pro Tem Holloway)
Relay for Life Report
Lujan moved to support the Relay for Life Event by loaning equipment at the same level as last year on the contingency that they seek assistance from the local church first; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Holloway, and Mendoza. NOES: None.
E-3
REQUEST TO CONSIDER JOINING SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS (SCAG) (Requested by Mayor Lujan)
SCAG Report
Lujan moved to join SCAG for the remainder of Fiscal Year 2007-2008 at prorated rate of $634.13, to appoint Mayor Lujan as the voting delegate, and to memorialize with a Resolution; seconded by Mendoza.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Holloway, and Mendoza. NOES: None.
